positions.title: Data 8 Head Undergraduate Student Instructor
positions.description: As a Head UGSI, I manage 30+ student instructors, 45+ tutors, 130+ lab assistants to serve the Intro to Data Science class of 1300+ students at UC Berkeley. Aside from the logistics of running the course, I also teach 2 2-hour labs that teach students with no background experience Python and data science.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: As a SWE Intern at NerdWallet, I revamped and improved the Home application flow for the Loans team. Using a shared state machine library and shared React components, I built out an experience from scratch to ask for user data so that users could compare offers and see personalized quotes for mortgages when purchasing a home or refinancing a mortgage. My project was the first step of an initiative to move towards a more consistent look and feel when asking users for data. Therefore, I learned a lot about persisting code and creating a foundation to drive greater efficiencies, iterate, and scale.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: As a SDE Intern at Amazon, I worked on the Financial Ledger and Accounting Services Hub internal software. I designed, implemented, and tested an efficient core feature for Amazon's complex rules engine that is used by dozens of teams in Amazon, including Accounting, Alexa, and Amazon Retail.

positions.title: Data 8 Undergraduate Student Instructor
positions.description: As a Undergraduate Student Instructor, I teach a 2-hour lab section of 35 students for Data8, Introduction to Data Science, at UC Berkeley. One of my accomplishments is tailoring material and concepts to students with no prior programming experience to encourage and excite new students in Computer Science.

volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteered as a co-counselor at the recreational summer camp, YMCA Camp Loma Mar, for campers ages 13 to 16. My main role was creating program-oriented activities meant to teach life lessons and reach socioeconomically disadvantaged youth.

As a camper in leadership training (CILT) at the recreational summer camp, YMCA Camp Loma Mar, I helped supervise cabins of  6-8 children, ages 7-12. I learned camp-specific leadership skills, like crisis management, purposeful communication, and connecting people from different backgrounds.

projects.title: Bear Maps
projects.description: I wrote code in Java for the a solo project of building back end of a web mapping application inspired by Google Maps and the OpenStreetMap project. I used tile images and map feature data to raster image tiles together, implementing zoom and translations on the map. I also implemented A* search for routing the directions for two input locations on the map. The project was done in Java.

projects.title: Relational Database Management System
projects.description: A class mate and I built a version of a Relational Database Management System as well as a Domain Specific Language similar to SQL with which a user can interact with a database. We implemented SQL queries like load, create, join, select, and many more. With .txt files, a user could load tables into the user's database and perform SQL operations. The project was done in Java.
